Section: Freelance and Project-Based Work
I am open to freelance or project-based work when the project is well-defined, practical, and aligned with my technical strengths.
I am especially suited for freelance or consulting work involving: - backend APIs - AI chatbot systems - RAG-based assistants - document processing and OCR workflows - dashboard and portal development - business process automation - Django and Next.js-based solutions

Section: Summary
I am open to full-time, contract, freelance, and consulting opportunities. I am especially open to roles in Dubai, Abu Dhabi, the UAE, or remote when the fit is strong. My compensation expectations should be discussed based on role scope, technical depth, leadership responsibility, and work arrangement.

Section: Role Fit Consideration
The most suitable opportunities for me are those where I can contribute through: - hands-on technical implementation - backend and AI system design - practical problem-solving - direct business impact - structured and production-oriented delivery

Section: Availability for Opportunities
I am open to hearing about suitable professional opportunities that match my background in AI, backend engineering, full-stack development, and intelligent automation systems.
I am especially interested in roles involving: - AI or LLM-enabled systems - backend engineering - Django or Python-based development - intelligent workflow automation - full-stack solution delivery - technical leadership or strong technical ownership

Section: Geographic Preference
I am especially open to opportunities in: - Dubai - Abu Dhabi - other suitable opportunities in the UAE - remote opportunities when the role is a strong fit
